architectural_change: Co-design O1 state-GEMM and score-times-V ownership so each true N16 output tile is already a compatible scoreV MMA accumulator fragment.
name: layout-codesigned-dual-causal-tile-pruning
removed_flop_claim_condition: N2 savings are conditional and have zero decision weight until the static hard gate passes.

static_hard_gate.pass: For exact short and long production tiled-MMA objects, every logical (d,n) in each N16 tile has a bijective equal lane and equal register offset under a same-iterator view, with no alias and preserved K accumulation order.
static_hard_gate.preferred_construction: logical_divide(real_output_fragment,(None,None,2)); select one MMA_N tile; reuse output.iterator and compare against the exact scoreV fragment layout
static_hard_gate.reject: Any register permutation/copy, shared/global handoff, barrier, extra allocation, changed per-element K order, or changed BF16 boundary rejects N2 before materialization.
